therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BRAF inhibition combined with immune activation via high-dose interleukin-2
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: targeted therapy combined with immunotherapy to enhance anti-tumor immune response

results.target_engagement_evidence: CD8/Treg ratio decreased from 43.9 pre-treatment to 20.5 after vemurafenib alone to 4.04 after aldesleukin
biomarker_changes: CD8/Treg ratio: 43.9 pre-treatment → 20.5 after vemurafenib alone → 4.04 after aldesleukin
safety_signals: All 6 participants experienced grade 3 severe adverse events
Serious adverse events included delirium and myocarditis

dose_info.dose: vemurafenib tablets twice daily; aldesleukin intravenous every 8 hours
dose_info.schedule: vemurafenib twice daily; aldesleukin every 8 hours for up to 14 doses per week
dose_info.dose_modifications: Mean aldesleukin dose completion: 73% course 1, 54% course 2

context.investigator_commentary: changes in available treatments for melanoma
